copper_metrics.justification: GT generator assigns copper=1.00 and the next-highest material, solder,=0.82; 0.91 is their midpoint.

swin_unetr_baseline.description: Original project Swin-UNETR baseline at padded input resolution.

csnet_no_compression.description: CS-Net modules and channel configuration retained; compression and matching upsampling are bypassed, so the same 24-channel Swin backbone runs at full resolution.
csnet_no_compression.adaptation: The stride-2 downsample and stride-2 transpose-convolution modules remain registered for parameter parity with D but are bypassed in forward().

csnet_compressed_no_hr_skip.description: Compressed CS-Net with HR fusion input removed; tail input channels are reduced from 48 to 24.

csnet_l1.description: Complete CS-Net with compression, latent Swin-UNETR, HR skip and fusion reconstruction.

csnet_mse.description: Architecturally identical to D; only the training and validation loss changes to MSE.

public_release_notes.path_policy: Replace paths above with local dataset locations before running.
